title: vaccinium uliginosum subsp. vulcanorum
intro: Vaccinium uliginosum subsp. vulcanorum, commonly known as the alpine cranberry, is a plant species in the heath family (Ericaceae) that is native to high-altitude areas of the mountainous regions in Europe and Asia. This plant is rich in antioxidants and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Vaccinium uliginosum subsp. vulcanorum include its potential to reduce oxidative stress, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
